overview: The Community Preservation Committee heard presentations for four proposed funding applications, including design studies for parks and historic landscape rehabilitation. The meeting also involved scheduling for upcoming deliberations and the mandatory annual public hearing.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved minutes from the July 10 and August 14 meetings.

items.title: Mystic Valley Parkway Shared-Use Path Study
items.summary: The Mystic River Watershed Association proposed a $60,000 feasibility and concept design study for a one-mile shared-use path and linear park along the Mystic Valley Parkway.

items.title: Slave Wall and Thomas Brooks Park Master Plan
items.summary: The Medford Historical Commission presented a master plan proposal to develop the six-acre Thomas Brooks Park to improve public access to and interpretation of a historic wall built by enslaved people.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Landscape Rehabilitation
items.summary: The committee reviewed a proposal to replace 20 unhealthy trees and install an informational kiosk in the historic Rock Garden section of Oak Grove Cemetery.

items.title: Hickey Park Canopy Improvement
items.summary: A proposal was presented to regrade the ground and install picnic tables under an existing canopy structure at Hickey Park to create a formal community gathering space.

items.title: Future Meeting Scheduling and Next Steps
items.summary: The committee established a calendar for project deliberations, the annual public hearing, and the potential review of an off-cycle application for the Chevalier Theater.
